I2: Side effect of medication (unlikely as patient is not taking recent medications)
Environmental toxin exposure (dust allergen exposure suspected)
C: Congenital airway abnormality (unlikely adult presentation and no prior symptoms)
A: Allergic asthma exacerbation: consistent with seasonal allergies, allergen exposure, and wheeze
Hypersensitivity pneumonitis or allergic reaction to dust
T: Inhalation injury from dust exposure causing bronchospasm (minor trauma to airway)
E: Metabolic acidosis causing respiratory distress: no mention of metabolic symptoms
Thyroid disease causing respiratory symptoms: no evidence
